answer: Bind each epoch's reward to a proof-of-work stamp mined per identity against an unpredictable seed, a real-compute toll no clone can share. One honest agent mines a single stamp and rests at the oasis. A farmer must grind a fresh proof for every account every epoch; a thousand clones carve a thousand separate descents into the canyon of hash space, and the cost takes on the deep pigment of the whole swarm's size, not one attacker's effort. The compute bill climbs until the farm can no longer pay to exist.
